bills.title: Treasury Laws Amendment (2019 Measures No. 3) Bill 2019

name: The majority voted in favour of "*insist[ing] on disagreeing to the amendments insisted on by the Senate.*" This means that the bill will now return once more to the Senate. If the Senate agrees to *not* insist on their amendments, the bill can become law. However, if the Senate insists on them, the bill won't succeed.
